info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/bria/text-to-image/hd
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/bria/text-to-image/hd queue.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.description: Guidance images to use for the generation. Up to 4 guidance methods can be combined during a single inference.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt you would like to use to generate images.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: The number of iterations the model goes through to refine the generated image. This parameter is optional.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: Which medium should be included in your generated images. This parameter is optional.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: A lone figure stands on the edge of a serene cliff at sunset, gazing out over a vast, mystical valley. The figure is clad in flowing robes that ripple in the gentle breeze, silhouetted against the golden and lavender hues of the sky. Below, a cascading waterfall pours into a sparkling river winding through a forest of bioluminescent trees. The scene blends the awe of nature with a touch of otherworldly wonder, inviting reflection and imagination.
prompt.description: The prompt you would like to use to generate images.

num_images.title: Num Images
num_images.description: How many images you would like to generate. When using any Guidance Method, Value is set to 1.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the image. When a guidance method is being used, the aspect ratio is defined by the guidance image and this parameter is ignored.

prompt_enhancement.title: Prompt Enhancement
prompt_enhancement.description: When set to true, enhances the provided prompt by generating additional, more descriptive variations, resulting in more diverse and creative output images.

method.title: Method
method.description: Which guidance type you would like to include in the generation. Up to 4 guidance methods can be combined during a single inference. This parameter is optional.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: The image that should be used as guidance, in base64 format, with the method defined in guidance_method_1. Accepted formats are jpeg, jpg, png, webp. Maximum file size 12MB. If more then one guidance method is used, all guidance images must be of the same aspect ratio, and this will be the aspect ratio of the generated results. If guidance_method_1 is selected, an image must be provided.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
